account_id.description: The account ID for which the rule should be suppressed. Example: '5d84e365-af8c-4d9f-8393-f1724bf60d8f'

note.description: Explains why the given check has been suppressed

region.description: The region to which the check applies. Either a specific region or 'global'

resource_id.description: The ID of the resource if the check should be suppressed only for a specific resource. Example: '/subscriptions/8dfbsdfe-we13-46we-9963-188868997f40/resourceGroups/myDevResources/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/myDevKeyVault-eastus'

rule_id.description: ID of the rule to be suppressed. Example: 'Resources-001'
